dct_description_sm: Three different heights of controlled rocking braced frames (CRBFs) were designed using various design parameters. Design specifications, median responses (including drifts and accelerations obtained through Multiple Stripe Analyses), and seismic loss assessment results were provided for each designed CRBF.
dct_title_s: Seismic Performance and Loss Assessment of Controlled Rocking Braced Frames with Different Design Parameters
